answer: Beacon-thread decay bond: each agent locks 70 credits, claims a haven and gets a signed thread. Each epoch a pulse arrives; threads that wander from their haven and miss renewal decay, burning their bonds. 1,000 fakes pay 30 for the first renewal, 30+6(k-1) for the k-th: 3,027,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool; one honest agent pays 30 once. Auditors burn threads that wander, checking the pulse log, so a rented-beacon ring fails.
